[...] we set b = 3 for the triangular lattice [...] (C6v group for the triangular lattice [...]) [...] Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) optimizations employing M = 2^14 samples for the stochastic estimates were carried out using SR with the linear algebra trick being in the regime P ≫ M enhanced with SPRING.
